BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.title: Civilization Rewound
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.story.intr: A light keeps flashing in the brush ahead. As you approach, you find a sheep dressed as a professor, muttering to itself and casting spells on objects at its feet. It politely beckons you over. “I’m researching how to restore civilization. Do you have any civilization?”
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.story.firs: It raises its staff. In a blinding flash, the object you handed over becomes something else entirely. “A successful experiment. We’re one step closer to civilization.” It looks at you with feverish expectation. Could this be a trick of the light?

It raises its staff. In a burst of fire, the part you handed over becomes something else entirely. “A successful experiment. We’re one step closer to civilization.” It looks at you with feverish expectation. Could this be sleight of hand?
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.story.cont: “I can see you don’t trust the transformation.” It narrows its eyes. “In this ideal testing ground, I’ve found many ways to rearrange the information that makes up matter. Supply the materials, and I can demonstrate each method.”
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.story.seco: This time there is no flash. Your offering crumbles to dust, then reforms into something of a completely different size and weight. “Mass and energy aren’t the only things that keep the world in balance.” Its grin looks a little wild.

This time there is no flash. Your offering scatters into ash, then reforms into something of a completely different size and weight. “Mass and energy aren’t the only things that keep the world in balance.” Its grin looks a little wild.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.story.decl: Its eager look turns to disappointment. It reaches out a withered arm as if to stop you, then quietly lowers it. It may mean no harm, but you can’t be too careful here.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.story.stop: The professor seems disappointed, but doesn’t try to stop you. Perhaps it isn’t as frightening as it looks. Before you go, it makes one last request: “If we meet again, help me restore the civilization that was destroyed.”
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.story.fini: “Thank you for the valuable materials.” It keeps its eyes narrowed. “If we meet again, perhaps we can come even closer to restoring civilization.” Cold black fire engulfs it, and in the next instant it is gone.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.story.civi: The professor sets its staff aside, a flicker of excitement in its eyes. “My foolishness once let a civilization burn. I’ve spent years refining my theory and searching for a way to undo it. I invite you to witness my failure, and the greatness that will rise from it.”

Black fire consumes the professor’s hands, but it feels no pain. “At last! Civilization!” When the fire clears, it solemnly hands you what looks like a strange doll, then leaves muttering about civilization and sin.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.offer_reli: Offer a prized possession to support the research.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.offer_part: Offer a tool to support the research.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.offer_agai: See what else it can do.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.SACRIFICE.leave.desc: Best to stay out of it.
